description: Knackpack's intent tracking: loads the rules and record at session start, reminds Claude to update the record with each message, and checks each turn for a missed update. Set KNACKPACK_INTENT=off to turn it off. Also prints knackpack's rules for challenging the developer instead of agreeing with them at session start; set KNACKPACK_CHALLENGE=off to turn that off. With KNACKPACK_DOCS=repo set, that hook also prints the rules for committing the requirements brief and the plan to .knackpack/ in the repository, in headless sessions too. At each message, warns when the conversation's context passes 400,000 tokens and asks Claude to stop for a checkpoint and compaction past 500,000; set KNACKPACK_CONTEXT=off to turn that off. Before each compaction, in headless sessions too, asks the summary to keep what Claude found out itself, with exact values, and its last numbered questions word for word; set KNACKPACK_COMPACT=off to turn that off.
